title: Uniqueness of a zero-shifted scalar Roos lift
statement: Two zero-shifted strict scalar Roos maps with equal unshifted nested tensor coordinates have equal localized maps.

proof.text: Use tensor balancing and sheafification to extend generator equality, then product and mapping-cocone extensionality and localization.
